emerging_technology: Generative-AI language-model systems for drafting and summarizing business text. No named vendor or current model capability is assumed.
intended_application: Draft internal weekly retail sales narratives from verified SQL/spreadsheet aggregates. Humans verify every number and interpretation before any business use. No automatic inventory actions.
organization: Hypothetical U.S. online apparel retailer, 120 employees; six reporting analysts of mixed experience and two assigned reviewers.
industry_sector: Online apparel retail in the United States; internal business reporting, not consumer advice or regulated professional advice.
business_need: Determine whether AI-assisted drafting can reduce total preparation and review effort while preserving factual accuracy compared with current manual templates and deterministic BI summaries.
users_stakeholders: Six reporting analysts, two reviewers, analytics manager as experiment sponsor, IT/data owner, and managers who rely on reports.
adoption_posture: Moderate / fast-follower: willing to run a reversible learning experiment, but requires local evidence before operational adoption.
capabilities_constraints: Hypothetical intake assumptions: a segregated evaluation environment is approved for non-sensitive aggregate tables only; two reviewers and a fallback manual process are assigned. Six analysts can participate in a four-week study. Actual model version, fully loaded costs and local performance are not supplied. No verified production readiness assessment exists.
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect numbers or unsupported causal explanations could mislead inventory decisions. Experiment outputs are quarantined from management decisions; manual reports remain authoritative. No personal/customer-level data, external publication, production integration or automated action is permitted.
management_question: What action should management take now for this application: adopt, bounded experiment, proof of concept, monitor, defer or reject? What would change it?
time_horizon: Decision on 1 November 2026; initial learning window four weeks after approved launch; reassess by 30 November 2026, with no automatic rollout.
additional_context:
This is a newly specified hypothetical teaching case, not evidence that the organization in Assignment 5 actually improved its controls. No local experiment has been performed. Peer retail-task diffusion is unknown.
